quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company targets under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2024-26: for fiscal 2026, the plan's final year (April 2026 to March 2027), business profit of JPY 40 billion, a business profit margin of 11.5% and ROE of 9%; for its 2030 vision, business profit of JPY 55 billion, a business profit margin of 13% and ROE of 10%. Over the plan's three years the company has set a capex budget of JPY 50 billion and a strategic investment budget of JPY 50 billion, plus a JPY 20 billion growth investment budget. FY to March 2026 actuals: business profit margin 10.8% (up 0.7 points), ROE 8.8% (up 2.3 points).
quarterly_data.figure: Plan final-year (April 2026 to March 2027) target business profit JPY 40 billion, margin 11.5%, ROE 9%; 2030 target business profit JPY 55 billion, margin 13%, ROE 10%

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor materials strategy: management states it will expand products for AI and next-generation communications in advanced semiconductor materials and optimize its production setup in China and Taiwan to strengthen global supply. On January 22, 2026 the company signed a share transfer agreement with Kyocera to acquire 100% of a newly established company that will take over part of Kyocera's chemical business (manufacture and sale of semiconductor epoxy molding compounds, semiconductor bonding pastes, industrial resins and others); the acquisition is scheduled for October 2026, for a consideration of JPY 30,000 million in cash (the final consideration is subject to price adjustment under the agreement). Management states that combining its technology with the new company's proprietary technology, including Kyocera's high thermal conductivity technology, will raise its presence in expanding markets such as AI data center applications.
quarterly_data.figure: 100% of the new company; consideration JPY 30,000 million (cash); acquisition scheduled October 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor substrate material LaZ series: in the fiscal year ended March 2026 sales for mobile devices grew and adoption in power devices for AI servers expanded (management's segment analysis). No single customer accounted for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D: group R&D expense was JPY 13,300 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, of which the semiconductor materials segment JPY 4,359 million. The segment focuses on AI, power and mobility and developed and launched five products in the year: a PDMS-free epoxy encapsulant for AI, a high thermal conductivity epoxy encapsulant for power semiconductors, a high thermal conductivity substrate material for power semiconductors, an epoxy resin for one-shot encapsulation for European HEV / EV vehicles, and an NMP-free photosensitive wafer coat resin. Company target: generate JPY 10 billion of business profit in fiscal 2030 from new products developed through innovation.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 13,300 million (semiconductor materials JPY 4,359 million); 5 semiconductor products launched

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex: JPY 19,276 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, of which semiconductor materials JPY 5,164 million, including expansion of epoxy molding compound production equipment at Sumitomo Bakelite (Suzhou) and Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore and a canteen / office building at Kyushu Sumitomo Bakelite. Capex plan for the following year: JPY 27,800 million, of which semiconductor materials JPY 8,800 million for capacity expansion and replacement of aging equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: FY capex JPY 19,276 million (semiconductor materials JPY 5,164 million); next-year plan JPY 27,800 million (semiconductor materials JPY 8,800 million)
